scope: CVG-004 bounded audited read-only supplier and expense registry report execution/export from the tenant-scoped finance expense catalog

criteria.description: The supplier/expense report gap, bounded contract, authority and explicit exclusions are recorded without promoting CVG-004 or global readiness.
criteria.limitations: This gate authorizes only on-demand read-only persisted finance catalog facts; supplier master semantics, payment advance, personalized reports, workers, providers, target and release remain excluded.

criteria.description: The finance expense catalog table, tenant-aware repository, runtime composition and billing.read boundary provide a coherent local source for the report without inferred supplier facts.
criteria.limitations: The source is an expense catalog, not a dedicated supplier master; route, source and browser evidence remain local until implementation and verification are complete.

criteria.description: Focused RED tests can reject the absent catalog definition, database source composition, persisted-field mapping and enabled SPA export before implementation.
criteria.limitations: Implementation, independent critique and post-implementation regression are required before any bounded checkpoint result.

gaps: The RED tests, implementation, independent critique and post-implementation regression are not complete at gate creation.

authority.scope: CVG-004 bounded on-demand read-only supplier and expense registry report execution/export
authority.decision: Authorize reversible repository implementation and local API/SPA/browser verification using only tenant-scoped persisted finance expense catalog facts and the existing audited ReportsService; no supplier CRUD, advance-payment ledger, inferred contact/tax/payment facts, worker scheduling, providers, credentials, target, production, deployment, external mutation or release acceptance.
authority.expires_or_revalidates: Revalidate before adding a dedicated supplier entity, scheduled delivery, payment-advance or personalized sources, unsupported fields, providers, target operations, production or release acceptance.

next_action: Write and run the focused module/API/SPA RED tests, then implement the smallest account-scoped persisted finance catalog report definition, source mapping and audited CSV action.
revalidation_triggers: Changes to finance catalog persistence, tenant repository queries or billing.read authorization
Changes to ReportsService execution/export or report-workbench behavior
Expansion beyond persisted read-only finance catalog facts
